verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Finix keeps a platform-held balance, topped up by ACH or wire before payouts (finix-docs-15), and that seller payouts are managed through the Dashboard and API (finix-docs-12). That shows funds have some home, but nothing explains where in-flight or held funds actually sit. missing for 10: documentation of the custody or holding structure for in-flight and held funds, any statement on whether balances earn yield, any description of segregation (e.g. FBO accounts) from Finix's own accounts, and independent corroboration.
